recognize_zh: 淋巴結中瀰漫的單形性小到中型淋巴球全部不著色，只有零星散在的細胞呈棕色膜狀或樹突狀染色；陰性的腫瘤細胞與散在陽性的背景細胞形成對比，標記未標示，需配合 CD20、CD5、cyclin D1 判讀套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells that are negative
Scattered individual positive cells with membranous to dendritic brown staining
No zonal or follicular distribution of the positive cells in this field
Neoplastic nuclei slightly irregular with scant cytoplasm (hematoxylin counterstain)
Positive cells account for a minor subset (<10%)
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) on a lymph node involved by a diffuse monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid proliferation shows that the neoplastic cells are negative. Scattered individual background cells show membranous to dendritic positivity without a zonal pattern. This pattern is most compatible with a marker of the non-neoplastic compartment (for example reactive T cells or histiocytes) in mantle cell lymphoma. Diagnostic confirmation rests on CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 staining.

ddx.vs: SLL shows proliferation centers with larger prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts and is CD23+, cyclin D1-negative.
MZL cells have more cytoplasm (monocytoid) and are CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
FL is CD10+/BCL6+ with centrocytes and centroblasts and lacks cyclin D1.
